paite: Amaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Jehoaddan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah / (2 Kum 14.2-6)
english: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih a, himahleh alungsim ape bukim kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, agam ahong dinkip in apa thattu, sikhate athat hi.
english: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.

paite: Himahleh atate uh bel athat kei a, Mosi Dan laibu a tuang, "Tate ziak in pate asi ding uh ahi kei, pate ziak in tate asi ding uh ahi sam kei, michih amau gitlouhna ziak in asi ding uh ahi,” chi a TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
english: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

paite: Amaziah in Judahte akaikhawm a, Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in sangkhat heutu leh zakhat heutute nuai ah a-omsak hi. Kum sawmnih tunglam teng asim a, mi teltuam, tei leh lum tawi thei, galkap thei mi nuaithum a-om uhi.
english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.

paite: Huan Israel gam a mi, mihat hangsan nuaikhat dangka talent zakhat in aguai lai hi.
heading: Edomte Toh Kidouna / (2 Kum 14.7)
english: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

paite: Himahleh, akiang ah Pathian mi, mi khat ahong a, "Aw Kumpipa, Israel sepaihte na kiang ah pai kei le uh, TOUPA Israel mite, Ephraim suante huam in, na kiang ah a-om kei hi.
english: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for Yahweh is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

paite: Hoh hi lechin leng, hangtak in kidouna ah gamtang in: huchi lou in zaw Pathian in melma mai ah nang a hon vuallelsak ding: Pathian in lah panpih theihna leh vuallelhsak theihna anei ngal a," ahong chi hi.
english: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ahihleh Israel sepaihte ka piaksa talent zakhat bang i chihta dia awi?" achi a. Huan Pathian mipa'n, "TOUPA'N huai sang a tampi nang ahon pe thei ahi,” achi hi.
english: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “Yahweh is able to give you much more than this.”

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Ephraim gam a kipan a sepaih hong paite paikik ding in akhen a; huaiziak in Judate tung ah aheh mahmah ua, hehtak in apaikikta uhi.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

paite: Amaziah in lunglel lou in mite apikhia a, Chi Phaizang ah ahoh ua, Seir suante singkhat athat uhi.
english: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

paite: Singkhat dang Judate'n ahingmat ua, suangpi vum ah api ua, suangpi vum a kipan in asawnkhe mengmeng ua, akitamzangawp uhi.
english: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

paite: Himahleh Amaziah in akiang ah galkap ding a pai lou ding a asawlkik sepaihte'n Judah gam khuate, Samaria a kipan a Beth-horon pha in asual ua, mi sangthum athat ua, gallak tampi ala uhi.
english: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, Amaziah, Edomte that ahong pai in Seir suante' pathiante ahon pua a, apathian ding in apangsak a, huchi in abia ua, gimlimte ahalsak chiat hi.
english: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

paite: Huaiziak in Amaziah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta a, akiang ah zawlnei asawl a, huai mi in akiang ah, "Na khut a kipan a amite hunkhe thei lou nam pathiante bang ding mahmah a zong na hia?" achi hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akiang a thu agen lai in kumpipa'n, "Kumpipa vaihawmpa ding in nang ka hon bawl ua hia? Dai mai in: bang ding a na hinna tan ding na hia?" achi a. Huchi in zawlnei in, "Pathian in hichibang a na hih ziak leh ka thuhilhna na ngaihkhiak louh ziak in nang hihmang lungsim in anei chih ka thei hi, achi a," adaita hi.
english: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Amaziah in thuhilh apom a, Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa, Jehoahaz tapa, Joash kiang ah, "Hong dih, kimatuah in i ki-en ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
heading: Israelte Toh Kidouna
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

paite: Israel kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, "Ka tapa zi ding in na tanu neisak dih, chi in athukhak a; huan, Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, ling ahong chilpukgawp hi.
english: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

paite: 'Nang ngai dih, Edom ka zou,' na chi a, na lungsim in na kisathei a, na inn ah om kinken mai in; nang leh Judah gam nangawn a siatna, nang dia poi ding thil bangziak a tokkhe ding na hia?" chi in mi asawl hi.
english: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”

paite: Himahleh, Amaziah in angaikhe nuam kei a; Edomte pathiante azon ziak a, Judah gam a amelmate uh khut a apiaktheihna ding a Pathian hih ahi.
english: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joash ahohtou a; Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah kimaituah in aki-enta ngei uhi.
english: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

paite: Huan Israelte sang in Judate tan ahong sezaw a; michih amau inn lam chiat ah apaita uhi.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.

paite: Israel kumpipa Joash in Beth-shemesh ah Judah kumpipa, Ahaziah tapa Jehoahaz tapa Amaziah aman a, Jerusalem ah api a, Jerusalem kulh Ephraim kulh kongpi a kipan akulh ning kongpi tan in tong zali tak achimsak hi.
english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

paite: Huan TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn agou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, henta koltang dingte toh, huan, Samaria kholam ah apaikik nawnta hi.
english: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah bel Israelte kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Joash sih nung in kum sawm-le-nga adam lai hi.
heading: Amaziah Sihna
english: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

paite: Amaziah thilhih dangte abul a pan atawp tan in ngai dih, Judah kumpite leh Israel kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in TOUPA zuih atawpsantak in Jerusalem ah thah asawm ua, Lakish ah atai a; himahleh khua ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athat uhi.
english: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

paite: Aluang sakol in apua ua, api-le-pute kiang Judah khopi ah avui uhi.
english: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
